source_notes: HAND-SEEDED BASELINE from the one-time manual sweep of https://agent.distributedapps.ai/directory on 2026-07-28 (4,515+ agents, AIVSS-scored), so the first automated run has something real to diff against instead of an empty month. KEY FINDING: the tight niche terms 'deal sourcing', 'M&A' and 'underwriting' (business M&A, not talent acquisition) returned ZERO direct competitors — no agent in the directory does buy-side deal sourcing or underwriting automation for acquirers (PE / ETA / family offices). The six entries below are the CLOSEST ADJACENT tools found, none of them direct competitors: Ava / Lucy / Placy PRO are sell-side real-estate broker-and-agent transaction copilots, Leni and Kolena Real Estate AI are real-estate analytics point tools, and Strabo is a portfolio tracker. Excluded as false positives on the word 'acquisition': 35+ generic lead-generation agents, sales-automation and CRM agents, and talent-acquisition/recruiting tools. CAVEAT: this sweep recorded agent NAMES but not canonical directory slugs or AIVSS scores, so the urls below are slugified from the names (aivss_score left null rather than guessed). If a slug differs from the real one, the first automated run will re-list that tool as a new entrant; because all six are loose adjacencies the worst case is a WATCH verdict, never a false ALERT.

entries.name: Ava
entries.description: Real-estate transaction copilot for brokers and listing agents: drafts listing content, answers buyer and seller questions, and moves a residential sale through to close. Sell-side representation workflow, not acquirer-side origination.

entries.name: Lucy
entries.description: Assistant for residential real-estate agents that handles client intake, listing questions and appointment scheduling. Consumer/agent productivity tool with no acquirer-side origination or financial screening.

entries.name: Placy PRO
entries.description: Professional real-estate copilot that answers property questions and guides brokers through a residential transaction. Property-level and sell-side, not portfolio or business acquisition.

entries.name: Leni
entries.description: Analytics and reporting layer over residential real-estate portfolio data: occupancy, rent roll and operational performance dashboards for property owners and managers. Reporting point tool, no origination or financing model.

entries.name: Kolena Real Estate AI
entries.description: Extracts and structures data from real-estate documents and property records for analysis. Document-intelligence point tool applied to property files, not an acquirer-side screening or financing engine.

entries.name: Strabo
entries.description: Tracks and consolidates personal and investment asset holdings across accounts into a single portfolio view. Post-purchase monitoring of assets already owned, with no origination or acquisition screening.
